ScreenRectangle and FullScreenRectangle

Source: R/changing.R
ScreenRectangleClass.Rd

Rectangles with the aspect ratio of the screen.

Usage

ScreenRectangle(aspect_ratio = 16/9, height = 4, ...)

FullScreenRectangle(...)

Arguments

aspect_ratio

Width divided by height.

height

Height.

...

Passed to Rectangle().
